home.proof.subhead: THREE PROOFS YOUR SCORE REFLECTS REAL PROGRESS
home.proof.repeatableFront: Run the same session twice and you get the same result.
home.proof.repeatableReveal: The scoring pipeline is deterministic and checksum-verified, so identical input produces identical output.
home.proof.realisticFront: Reference pace is physics-based, not arbitrary.
home.proof.realisticReveal: Corner expectations are derived from vehicle behavior and track geometry, so coaching stays grounded in race reality.
home.proof.contextFront: Grip, weather, and setup changes are recognized.
home.proof.contextReveal: Condition-aware adjustments keep progress tracking fair from session to session and weekend to weekend.
home.product.coachingTagline: After every session. Know exactly where to improve.
home.product.coachingTab1Desc: Five pillars — Pace, Consistency, Execution, Robustness, Adaptation — each scored with color-coded bars. Session info, kart, conditions, and best lap at a glance.
home.product.coachingTab2Desc: Track map, GG diagram, speed trace, and lap overlay in one immersive split-screen view. Keyboard-driven, distraction-free analysis.
home.product.coachingTab3Desc: Best time, mean, median, consistency CV — plus a full lap-by-lap bar chart with best lap highlighted. Spot trends across the session.
home.product.strategyTagline: On race day. Plan your stints, track fuel, and know when to pit.
home.product.strategyTab1Desc: Set race duration, stint count, minimum pit time, and fuel autonomy. See your full stint timeline at a glance before you roll out.
home.product.strategyTab2Desc: Estimated laps per stint, average stint time, fuel start/end, ballast, and pit lap targets — all in one table.
home.product.strategyTab3Desc: Elapsed and remaining timers. Fuel level with burn rate. Current stint progress bar. Pit In, Re-Optimize, and Pause controls.
home.workflow.cardDescription: Every module is mapped to live capability status, so you know exactly what is ready now and what is on the roadmap.
